title: Subscribe
text: Receive messages from ROS 2 network, 2 outputs, {Topic source} sets Source for specifying topic name Select from ROS network; {Topic}, {Message type} sets the rOS 2 message, {Sample time} sets the interval between outputs, {History} sets the mode of storing messages in the queue Keep, {Depth} sets the size of the message queue, {Reliability} sets the delivery guarantee, {Durability} sets the persistence of messages, {Deadline} sets the expected interval between consecutive message receptions, {Lifespan} sets the message validity window between publishing and reception, {Liveliness} sets the publisher aliveness asserting protocol and {Lease Duration} sets the maximum time window between liveliness assertions. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Topic source
params.values: Source for specifying topic name Select from ROS network | Specify your own

params.name: Topic
params.values: Topic name to subscribe to string

params.name: History
params.values: Mode of storing messages in the queue Keep last (default) | Keep all

params.name: Depth
params.values: Size of the message queue 10 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Reliability
params.values: Delivery guarantee of messages Reliable (default) | Best effort

params.name: Durability
params.values: Persistence of messages Volatile (default) | Transient local

params.name: Deadline
params.values: Expected interval between consecutive message receptions Inf (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Lifespan
params.values: Message validity window between publishing and reception Inf (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Lease Duration
params.values: Maximum time window between liveliness assertions Inf (default) | positive scalar
